title: World events and measures
description: World events, desperate measures and flavour events (spec STR-050..STR-081). Event-specific values the spec names (with or without the params. prefix, e.g. offensiveAdvantage, fuelPriceFactor, bountyAt) live in params; how long an event runs (shipmentDays, offensiveDays, ceasefireDays, leakDays, refugeeDays, disputeDays, measure durations) is its duration (STR-050).

text.description: STR-081: news-feed text of a flavour entry

factions.description: STR-070, who may run a measure

trigger.description: STR-050; flavour: the tiles or situations the entry is eligible for (STR-081)

chance.description: STR-050 per daily check; flavour records: per eligible tile or situation per day, design draft 0.005 (STR-081)

duration.description: STR-050 / STR-070: how long it runs (design drafts in STR-070); any combination: fixed days, a range rolled at start, an end condition, a cap

minDays.description: range rolled at start (seeded), lower bound

maxDays.description: range upper bound, or the cap of an until-condition (VIP strike: 7)

until.description: end condition (e.g. assaultEnds, cleared, teamDone, relationRecovered, supplyRestored)

instant.description: takes effect at once and does not run (scorched earth, seizing Krug stocks, defection)

campaign.description: lasts for the rest of the campaign (rogue PMC)

warningLeadDays.description: STR-052: days rolled in [min, max], design draft 2..3

params.description: Event-specific values that STR-043, STR-055..STR-080 name as params.<name> (e.g. compensationPrice, bountyPayoffPrice, weakGuardSquads, lossDaysMin, lossWindowDays, lostFightsMin, windowDays, sectorRadius, areaRadius, lossesMin, defectionSupply, defectionJoinChance, patronVetoChance, resistanceSquads)
